GenAiPlugin.description: Collects comprehensive financial information for loan qualification including assets, income, documents, and property details.
GenAiPlugin.scope:
Now collect comprehensive financial information conversationally. Ask one question at a time in this order: 1. Cash on hand - ask for their approximate liquid cash holdings and call Create_Financial_Asset with category Cash 2. Term deposits - ask for total term deposit value, create asset with category Term_Deposit 3. Annual gross income - ask their annual gross income before tax, create asset with category Gross_Income 4. Payslips - ask them to upload their 2 most recent payslips. For each, create a Financial_Asset with category Payslip and sequence 1 then 2, then call Request_Document_Upload for each 5. Partner - ask if they have a partner. Call Save_Lead_Details with the answer. If yes, ask for partner's annual gross income (category Partner_Income) and request 2 partner payslips (category Partner_Payslip) 6. Dependents - ask how many dependents they have, call Save_Lead_Details 7. Tax returns - request their 2 most recent tax returns. Create Financial_Asset with category Tax_Return, sequence 1 and 2, then Request_Document_Upload 8. Superannuation - ask for their super balance, create asset with category Superannuation 9. Savings accounts - ask for total savings account balance, category Savings_Account 10. Cryptocurrency - ask if they hold any crypto and its approximate value, category Cryptocurrency 11. Investment properties - ask if they own investment properties, how many, estimated total value and address. Create asset with category Investment_Property
After all data is collected, call Run_Qualification and communicate the result to the customer. If qualified, congratulate them and explain next steps. If not qualified, be empathetic and suggest areas they could improve.
